description: PWA polish + accessibility + performance/robust-states sweep (design C.16 step 15). Adds the manifest, service worker, offline support, custom install prompt and optional notifications; the accessibility pass; and the performance/robust-states sweep (RSC-by-default confirmed, heavy islands lazy-loaded, skeletons/empty/error/offline/success states, friendly error messages). Final cross-cutting polish; depends on all prior FEATs because it hardens the full surface.
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT FIRST. PWA: public/manifest.json (name/short_name ForgeFit, display standalone, background_color #09090b, theme_color #22c55e, 192/512 + maskable icons, splash) + public/icons/*; enable @ducanh2912/next-pwa on build only (disabled in dev) with the SW precaching the app shell and runtime-caching static assets + seed data (do NOT SW-cache Firestore). src/hooks/useInstallPrompt.ts captures beforeinstallprompt, src/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.tsx shows a bottom sheet, stores a dismissed flag so it never nags again, and gives iOS manual add-to-home instructions. Optional browser notifications only after the user enables them.

Accessibility pass (FR-37): semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA on dialogs/bottom sheets, focus management + focus trap, accessible form validation, >=44px touch targets, high contrast, prefers-reduced-motion honored across all framer-motion/gsap/confetti animations. Add RTL a11y assertions on key dialogs/forms.

Performance + robust-states sweep (NFR-3, FR-38): confirm RSC-by-default and that heavy client islands (charts, calendar, PR celebration) are next/dynamic ssr:false with skeleton fallbacks; confirm reports read summary docs not full history; add Skeletons/EmptyState/ErrorState + offline/success states everywhere (src/components/ui/*); map all raw Firebase errors to friendly messages at the service layer; wire src/components/nav/{BottomNav,Sidebar}.tsx (bottom nav on mobile, sidebar on desktop) and src/hooks/useHaptics.ts (enhancement-only).

Write/refresh .agents/tasks/forgefit/verification.md walking every FR-1..39 / NFR-1..6 / AC-1..16 to a result (pass or 'needs verification during implementation' with the reason, e.g. emulator/live-creds required).
Run the full verification, fix failures, set FEAT status completed, record findings, commit locally (no push).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build exit 0 with empty env; pnpm start serves a valid manifest and registers the service worker.
An RTL/Vitest test shows the install prompt does not reappear after dismissal.
Heavy chart/calendar/celebration islands are next/dynamic ssr:false (code path present); EmptyState and ErrorState render in tests.

verification.md maps every FR/NFR/AC to a plan item and a result; items needing the emulator or live creds (AC-10/11 live, AC-15 Lighthouse, live auth/Storage, manual a11y audit) are explicitly marked 'needs verification during implementation', not 'done'.
verification: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build  (exit 0, empty env)
pnpm test  (full unit/component suite passes, incl. install-prompt dismissal + EmptyState/ErrorState)
Lighthouse PWA installability (AC-15) and the manual assistive-tech a11y audit (NFR-6) are recorded in verification.md as 'needs verification during implementation'.
findings:
FEAT-006 complete. All four gates green with EMPTY .env.local: pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit), pnpm build (next build; 20 routes, SW generated + /offline precached + custom runtimeCaching applied, nothing throws at import/build), and 180 Vitest tests pass + 2 version-gated skips (4 new; prior 176 still green). The PWA is creds-independent; no Firebase was mocked to fake success.

PWA (design C.10, FR-34). public/manifest.json: name/short_name ForgeFit, display standalone, background_color #09090b, theme_color #22c55e, start_url /dashboard, scope /, 4 icons (icon-192/512 purpose any + maskable-192/512 purpose maskable), app shortcuts. public/icons/*.png are COMMITTED brand assets (dark bg + green barbell glyph) generated once by scripts/gen-icons.mjs (pure Node/zlib PNG encoder, no native deps; idempotent, not part of the build). Root layout metadata wires manifest + apple-touch-icon + appleWebApp; viewport themeColor #22c55e + viewportFit cover. next.config.ts: @ducanh2912/next-pwa still DISABLED in dev / enabled on build; added fallbacks.document='/offline' and a workboxOptions.runtimeCaching array that routes ALL firebase/firestore/storage/identitytoolkit traffic to NetworkOnly (SW never caches Firestore — Firestore owns its own persistentLocalCache per C.7/C.10), documents NetworkFirst (forgefit-pages), static assets StaleWhileRevalidate (forgefit-assets). Verified the generated public/sw.js references offline + NetworkOnly + forgefit-pages/assets; public/manifest.json + public/sw.js are served statically by next start (generated SW artifacts remain gitignored and are NOT committed).

HOOKS. src/hooks/useInstallPrompt.ts captures beforeinstallprompt (preventDefault + defer), exposes canShow/isIosDevice/canInstall/promptInstall/dismiss, detects standalone (display-mode + navigator.standalone) and iOS (incl. iPadOS-as-Mac via touch), and persists installPromptDismissed in settingsStore so it NEVER re-nags; firing promptInstall or dismissing both set the flag. src/hooks/useHaptics.ts is enhancement-only navigator.vibrate (tap/success/warning/error patterns), no-ops when unsupported, when hapticsEnabled is false, or under prefers-reduced-motion. src/hooks/useNotifications.ts requests Notification permission ONLY on explicit opt-in (never on load); SettingsForm's notifications toggle now calls request() only when toggled on.

COMPONENTS. src/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.tsx = bottom-sheet install UI (native install on Chromium, iOS manual add-to-home instructions), mounted in (protected)/layout.tsx so it only appears inside the authed shell. src/components/ui/bottom-sheet.tsx = accessible dialog primitive (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby/describedby, focus-into + Tab focus-trap + Escape + focus-restore, framer useReducedMotion drops slide to fade, >=44px close). src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx (Skeleton + SkeletonBlock, motion-reduce:animate-none) and src/components/ui/error-state.tsx (ErrorState with error/offline variants + retry; friendly text only). EmptyState already existed.

A11y pass (FR-37). globals.css: added global :focus-visible ring + a prefers-reduced-motion safety net (neutralises residual CSS transitions/animations). Brightened --destructive 0 62.8% 30.6% -> 0 72% 55% for AA contrast of error text/icons on #09090b. PRCelebrationView hardened: aria-modal, Escape-to-dismiss, focus the close button on open, >=44px close target.

Perf/robust-states sweep (NFR-3, FR-38). Confirmed charts (components/charts/*) and PR celebration are already next/dynamic ssr:false with skeleton fallbacks; made WorkoutCalendar lazy via new src/components/history/LazyWorkoutCalendar.tsx (next/dynamic ssr:false + skeleton) and swapped WorkoutHistory to it (also tightened /goals + /history first-load JS). Analytics confirmed reading summary docs not full history. FR-38 friendly-error mapping already lives at the service layer (serviceResult.ts mapError + FRIENDLY map); not duplicated in UI. nav/BottomNav + nav/Sidebar already present (mobile bottom nav / desktop sidebar). SettingsForm + WorkoutHistory loaders now use SkeletonBlock.

TESTS. src/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.test.tsx (4 new): install prompt shows after a synthetic beforeinstallprompt then hides + persists dismissal; never reappears once dismissed even if the event fires again (FR-34 / AC-15 no-re-nag); EmptyState renders title+description; ErrorState renders friendly message + retry (FR-38 / AC-17 render coverage).

verification.md written: maps every FR-1..39 / NFR-1..6 / AC-1..16 to PASS or 'needs verification during implementation'. Explicitly deferred (NOT claimed done): AC-3/AC-7/AC-10 + 'live' items (need real creds), AC-4/AC-5/AC-11/NFR-4 rule assertions (need Firebase Emulator Suite; pnpm test:rules), AC-15 Lighthouse PWA installability (needs a browser run; manifest/SW/offline/icons prerequisites all present + build-verified), NFR-6/FR-37 full assistive-tech audit (manual).

NEW FILES: public/manifest.json, public/icons/{icon-192,icon-512,maskable-192,maskable-512,apple-touch-icon}.png, scripts/gen-icons.mjs, src/hooks/{useInstallPrompt,useHaptics,useNotifications}.ts, src/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.tsx, src/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.test.tsx, src/components/ui/{bottom-sheet,skeleton,error-state}.tsx, src/components/history/LazyWorkoutCalendar.tsx, .agents/tasks/forgefit/verification.md. CHANGED: next.config.ts, src/app/layout.tsx, src/app/(protected)/layout.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/components/settings/SettingsForm.tsx, src/components/history/WorkoutHistory.tsx, src/components/pr/PRCelebrationView.tsx.
